source.title: Forum Digest (December 2021)
source.content:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA Forum from the previous few months.

[**Removing 4-pad mode functionality in Gen5 timers**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/removing-4-pad-mode-functionality-in-gen5-timers/15900)
The new Gen5 timers released from the Speed Stacks company had mixed reviews from the community. An active speedcuber, Callum, discusses how to apply a simple modification to the timer to make it work like the original 2-pad touch timers.

[**2022 WCA Regulations feedback**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/asking-for-feedback-on-2022-regulations-and-guidelines/16092)
The WCA Regulations Committee asked for community feedback on the changes that they are implementing next year to the WCA Regulations and Guidelines. We will be hearing about all the finalized changes for 2022 next month.

[**Cumulative time limits in sighted events**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/proposal-allow-for-both-cumulative-time-limits-and-time-limits/16323)
In the current Regulations, cumulative time limits can only be used if individual solve time limits are not used for the event. Most commonly, these are used for blindsolving events which allows competitors to complete the entire round of an event within an estimated overall time. Kit proposes that we have the system of cumulative time limits for sighted events that allows for individual solve time limits to be applied as well, as it will improve competition schedules and overall management of the time taken by each competitor to complete their attempts.

[**Four World Records from Max Park in a single day**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/max-park-3x3-wr-average-5-47-seconds/16283)
Max Park broke four world records in one day at a competition in the US in Missoula, Montana. He broke the 3x3 World Record twice, reducing it to a 5.32 second average, the 4x4 Record, resulting in a 20.94 second average, and finally the One-Handed Record with a 9.34 second average. Congratulations to Max!

[**Three World Records from Zayn Khanani in the 2x2 event**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wr-zayn-khanani-2x2-average-1-13/15122)
Zayn Khanani, over the course of the last few weeks, went on a spree and broke the 2x2 World Record twice at different competitions. He reduced the 2x2 Average Record to 1.13 seconds, then 1.06 seconds, and finally 1.05 seconds. He is currently attending more competitions across the USA and the world, and there is a high chance that we will see another World Record from him soon. 

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback, please send an email to [advisory@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:advisory@worldcubeassociation.org) or participate in the discussions on the threads yourself!

Thanks to everyone for being a part of the Forum by sharing important feedback and adding value to the discussions.

translation.title: WCA 论坛精选（2021 年 12 月）
translation.content:
以下是过去几个月 WCA 论坛上值得关注的几个话题。

[**移除第五代计时器的四触点模式**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/removing-4-pad-mode-functionality-in-gen5-timers/15900)

Speed Stacks 新推出的第五代计时器在社区中褒贬不一。活跃的速拧选手 Callum 介绍了如何简单改装计时器，使其像原来的双触点计时器一样工作。

[**2022 年 WCA 竞赛规则意见征集**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/asking-for-feedback-on-2022-regulations-and-guidelines/16092)

WCA 规则委员会就明年计划实施的《WCA 竞赛规则与指南》改动征求社区意见。下个月，我们将看到 2022 年最终确定的全部改动。

[**明拧项目的累计时限**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/proposal-allow-for-both-cumulative-time-limits-and-time-limits/16323)

按现行规则，只有在项目不设单次还原时限时，才可使用累计时限。累计时限最常用于盲拧项目，让选手在预计的总时长内完成整轮比赛。Kit 建议为明拧项目引入可同时设置单次时限的累计时限制度，以改善赛程安排，更好地管理每位选手完成全部还原所需的时间。

[**Max Park 一天打破四项世界纪录**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/max-park-3x3-wr-average-5-47-seconds/16283)

Max Park 在美国蒙大拿州米苏拉的一场比赛中，一天内四次打破世界纪录。他两次刷新三阶平均世界纪录，将其降至 5.32 秒；以 20.94 秒刷新四阶平均世界纪录；最后又以 9.34 秒刷新单手平均世界纪录。祝贺 Max！

[**Zayn Khanani 三次刷新二阶世界纪录**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wr-zayn-khanani-2x2-average-1-13/15122)

过去几周，Zayn Khanani 状态火热，在不同比赛中两次打破二阶世界纪录。他先将二阶平均世界纪录降至 1.13 秒，随后是 1.06 秒，最后是 1.05 秒。他目前仍在参加美国及世界各地的比赛，很有可能很快再次打破世界纪录。

如有问题、意见或反馈，请发送邮件至 [advisory@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:advisory@worldcubeassociation.org)，也欢迎直接参与相关帖子的讨论！

感谢大家分享重要反馈、认真参与讨论，一起建设论坛。
notes: Zayn 段原文标题及成绩列出三次纪录，正文却写 twice；译文保留该矛盾，不擅自修正。
